accelerationUnit: g (includes gravity); gravity.csv is CoreMotion gravity in g
axes: Unmodified CoreMotion device axes: x right, y top, z out of screen in portrait. No sign changes. Intrinsics refer to unrotated encoded pixel buffer.
clockMapping: host_sec = CMSyncConvertTime(source_pts, session.synchronizationClock, CMClockGetHostTimeClock()); video_sec = source_pts - firstVideoPTS
exposureSource: AVCaptureDevice property sampled at callback; not guaranteed frame-exact
motionClock: CoreMotion seconds since boot; original timestamps, including preroll
